name: FraudCoins public dataset
updateCadence: assets above $50M market cap: daily. $10M–$50M tier: rotated, at most every 10 days. Read each row's sampledAt for the authoritative date.
access: static JSON over HTTPS — no key, no registration, no rate limit; CORS enabled

endpoints.title: Holder concentration
endpoints.description: Top-10 holder share per measured token, corrected and uncorrected, with the sample size and measurement date.

endpoints.title: Correction evidence
endpoints.description: The wallets excluded from each top-10 figure, with the reason and stake size.

endpoints.title: Contract permissions
endpoints.description: Owner privileges and structural contract properties, as reported by GoPlus Labs static analysis.

endpoints.title: Risk verdicts
endpoints.description: Frozen daily risk score, level and flags per coin.

endpoints.title: Concentration history
endpoints.description: Dated concentration series per coin, up to 180 points.

endpoints.title: Recent flags
endpoints.description: Concentration events by day. Most entries are kind "first-measured" (the asset was measured for the first time and was already above the threshold); "crossed" means it moved across the threshold between two measurements.

endpoints.title: Coin index
endpoints.description: id, name and symbol for every actively-listed asset. Delisted pages are excluded.

disclaimer: Risk scores and flags are automated, opinion-based assessments derived from public market data. They are not statements of fact, financial advice, or allegations of illegal conduct against any project or person. Contract permissions are read from deployed bytecode and are factual. Excluded-holder classifications rely on third-party address labels, which are reproduced verbatim so they can be checked; an unlabelled custodial wallet is counted as private.
